voice.name: Eliot - Relaxed & Casual
voice.why: A relaxed, casual French voice for the town civilians. The game has male bodies only; the voice is male.

what.text: I live here. I get by, as everyone does. The work is simple and the people are decent.

where.text: The town board on the square shows everything. The post office hires couriers, and the bank is beside it.

rumour.text: People say the police are watching the main street. Burglars are about. Keep your doors locked.
